title.zh: 摩根大通预计未来十年比特币将跑赢美股和黄金
title.en: JPMorgan Sees Bitcoin Outperforming U.S. Stocks and Gold Over Next Decade

current_state.zh: JPMorgan Asset Management首次将比特币纳入长期资本市场假设，基准预测10%年化回报、牛市16.6%、熊市-11.2%，高于美国大盘股7.5%和黄金5.5%，但强调高波动和不稳定相关性限制其当前组合分散化作用。
current_state.en: JPMorgan Asset Management included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time, with a 10% base-case annualized return, 16.6% bull case, and -11.2% bear case, above U.S. large caps at 7.5% and gold at 5.5%, while stressing that high volatility and unstable correlations limit its current portfolio-diversification role.

updates.what_changed_zh: 摩根大通资产管理首次将比特币纳入其长期资本市场假设，预计未来10至15年复合年回报率为10%，高于美国大盘股的7.5%和黄金的5.5%，年化波动率为55%。
updates.what_changed_en: JPMorgan Asset Management included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time, projecting a 10% compound annual return over 10-15 years — above U.S. large-cap stocks at 7.5% and gold at 5.5% — with 55% annualized volatility.

updates.title_zh: 摩根大通预计未来十年比特币将跑赢美股和黄金
updates.title_en: JPMorgan projects Bitcoin to outperform US stocks and gold over next decade
updates.what_changed_zh: 同一份JPMorgan 2027长期资本市场假设报告补充了比特币牛市年化回报16.6%、熊市年化亏损11.2%的情景预测，并明确称当前不将比特币视为投资组合分散化工具，而是投机性资产和对冲货币宽松的工具。
updates.what_changed_en: The same JPMorgan 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report added bull-case 16.6% and bear-case -11.2% annualized Bitcoin return scenarios, and explicitly said Bitcoin is not currently viewed as a portfolio diversifier but as a speculative asset and hedge against monetary easing.
updates.current_state_zh: JPMorgan Asset Management首次将比特币纳入长期资本市场假设，基准预测10%年化回报、牛市16.6%、熊市-11.2%，高于美国大盘股7.5%和黄金5.5%，但强调高波动和不稳定相关性限制其当前组合分散化作用。
updates.current_state_en: JPMorgan Asset Management included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time, with a 10% base-case annualized return, 16.6% bull case, and -11.2% bear case, above U.S. large caps at 7.5% and gold at 5.5%, while stressing that high volatility and unstable correlations limit its current portfolio-diversification role.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: JPMorgan Asset Management's long-term outlook projects Bitcoin will return 10% annualized over the next decade, outperforming US large-cap stocks and gold, while cautioning that volatility and unstable correlations limit its portfolio role.
updates.detailed_summary_en: JPMorgan Asset Management's long-term outlook projects Bitcoin will return 10% annualized over the next decade, outperforming US large-cap stocks and gold, while cautioning that volatility and unstable correlations limit its portfolio role.
